msg.title: Messages
msg.settings_sub: Choose which messages show in your inbox and on the badge.
msg.offline: You are offline. Messages will refresh when your connection returns.
msg.empty.order_hint: When the shop confirms or ships an order, the update appears here.
msg.empty.alert_hint: Opening hours, closures and other store notices will appear here.
msg.empty.promo_hint: New offers from the shop will appear here.
msg.order.guest_title: Sign in to see order updates
msg.order.guest_body: Order updates are private, so they are shown only in your account. You can still track any order with its link or number.
msg.order.pending_confirmation.title: Order {n} received
msg.order.pending_confirmation.body: The shop has your order and will confirm it soon.
msg.order.confirmed.title: Order {n} confirmed
msg.order.processing.title: Order {n} is being prepared
msg.order.dispatched.title: Order {n} is on the way
msg.order.dispatched.body: Your order has left the shop.
msg.order.delivered.title: Order {n} delivered
msg.order.delivered.body: Your order has been delivered. Thank you for shopping with us.
msg.order.cancelled.title: Order {n} cancelled
msg.order.rejected.title: Order {n} could not be accepted
msg.order.rejected.body: The shop could not accept this order. Open it to see more.
msg.order.update.title: Order {n} updated
msg.order.update.body: There is a new update on your order.
msg.gate.sub: Order updates, shop news and chat with the shop, all in one place.
msg.gate.signin_hint: Keeps your chat and order updates with your account on any device.
msg.gate.guest_hint: Your name helps the shop recognise your chat. This browser keeps the conversation private to you.
msg.gate.expired: Your guest session expired. Sign in, or continue as a guest again.
msg.guest.name: Your name
msg.guest.phone_hint: Nepal numbers work as they are. For other countries start with + and the country code.
msg.guest.phone_bad: Enter a valid phone number, for example 98XXXXXXXX or +61 4XX XXX XXX.
msg.guest.private: A phone number alone never unlocks a chat. Sign in to keep it across devices.
msg.guest.switch_warn: You will no longer be able to open this guest chat from this browser. Sign in first if you want to keep it.
msg.chat.title: Chat with the shop
msg.chat.sub: Ask about products, delivery or an order
msg.chat.resolved: Marked as resolved. Send a message to reopen it.
msg.chat.empty_hint: Write your first message below and the shop will reply here.
msg.err.load_hint: Check your connection and try again.
msg.err.send: Your message was not sent. Try again.
msg.err.rate: You are sending messages too quickly. Wait a minute and try again.
msg.err.guest: Could not start a guest session. Please try again.
msg.pref.in_app_hint: Unread badges and the message list. On by default.
msg.pref.orders_hint: Confirmed, on the way, delivered and more.
msg.pref.replies_hint: When the shop answers your chat.
msg.pref.announcements_hint: Opening hours, closures and important notices.
msg.pref.promos_hint: Offers and new arrivals. You can turn these off.
msg.pref.push_off: Phone or browser push notifications are not available for messages yet. New messages show here and on the badge.
msg.pref.err: Your setting could not be saved.
